title: The Squirrel Who Planted a Forest 🐿️🌳
yt_title: The Squirrel Who Planted a Forest 🐿️🌳
yt_description:
"You'll never find them all, Nutty!" Carl the crow was right... and that was the plan. 🌳
A squirrel can bury up to 3,000 nuts in one season. The acorns it never digs up can grow into new oak trees. (Nutty and Carl are fictional; the science is real.)

Sources: Scientific American (via Forest Preserve District of Will County); Smithsonian Science Education Center; Britannica.

caption:
"You'll never find them all, Nutty!" 🐿️🌳 Carl the crow didn't see the forest coming.
Squirrels bury up to 3,000 nuts a season, and the forgotten acorns grow into oak trees.
Who's the real forgetful genius here? 😄

script: Every autumn, Nutty the squirrel buries acorns. Hundreds. Then thousands. Carl: Ha! You'll never find them all, Nutty! Nutty: I don't need to find them all. Winter comes. Nutty digs up acorn after acorn... but some stay buried. Carl: See? You forgot that one! Nutty: Wait for spring. Spring. Little green shoots pop up everywhere. Carl: Wait... you planted a forest?! Squirrels really do this: they bury thousands of acorns, and the ones they never dig up can grow into new oak trees. And Carl? He's got a brand new home.
